pages.text: TechCraft adds a vast array of materials to the game that you can use for crafting advanced items and machines. This section covers all the materials you can find, mine, and craft.

Materials include:$(br)• Raw Resources (Tin, Rubber)$(br)• Ingots (Tin, Steel, Bronze, Nickel, Silver, Prismite, Quantum)$(br)• Plates (All metals + special materials)$(br)• Dusts (Coal, Iron, Nickel, Steel)$(br)• Cables (10 types from Bronze to Quantum)$(br)• Electronics (Circuits, Resistors, etc.)$(br)• Energy Storage (Batteries, Crystals)$(br)• Special Materials (Rubies, Plasma Cores)
